integrity: Analytic argument uses the cited exact density formula and new uniform denominator separation. Exact-rational finite checks are supplementary only. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: The result refines a previously known exact limiting density for the slope-two flat-spot family. It concerns a specified pointwise version near one endpoint; no finite-time convergence rate or other slopes are treated.
title: Dyadic boundary layers and a complete endpoint phase law for flat-spot-map fluctuations
